## API reference (https://getaight.ai/docs/reference/)

Documentation
Quickstart API reference Authentication Models Credits & billing Get help
API reference
Request structure, authentication and errors.
POST /chat/completions
Authentication
Send your API key as a bearer token.
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
Request body
model string · required
messages array · required
stream boolean · optional
Response states
200 · Success 401 · Invalid credentials 429 · Rate limit reached 5xx · Service error


## The Aight API (https://getaight.ai/api/)

API / Start here
The Aight API
Last updated 15 September 2026
Ashva Intelligence Pvt Ltd
This is the address your software talks to. This page is the whole of it: where to
point your code, how to get a key, what you pay, and what every error means. If you have
written code against OpenAI before, your first call is about five minutes away.
The short version
Address
https://api.getaight.ai/v1
Shape
OpenAI-compatible. Change the base address and the key in your existing code. Nothing else.
Key
Create an account at console.getaight.ai , then we issue the key. We approve new accounts within 24 hours, weekends included.
Payment
Prepaid in rupees. Minimum top-up ₹500 . No card on file, no monthly bill.
Money refusal
Always a 402 , never a 429 . A 402 means stop and top up, not retry.
Help
hello@getaight.ai , 9 am to 9 pm IST, seven days a week. A founder replies.
01 The address
Send your requests here. This is the only address you need.
Base address
https://api.getaight.ai/v1
The Aight API is OpenAI-compatible . That means it speaks the same
language as OpenAI's own API: the same paths, the same request shape, the same reply
shape. So any tool that already talks to OpenAI talks to us after you change two
things — the base address and the key. The official OpenAI libraries for Python and
Node, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Cursor, and plain curl all work this way.
These are the paths open to you today.
Path
What it does
POST /v1/chat/completions
Send messages to a model and read its reply. This is the one almost everybody uses.
POST /v1/embeddings
Turn text into numbers for search and matching.
GET /v1/models
List the models your key is allowed to call. Send your key with it.
cohere-command-a , deepseek-r1 , DeepSeek-V3.2 , deepseek-v3.2-aws , DeepSeek-V3.2-Speciale , DeepSeek-V4-Flash , DeepSeek-V4-Pro , devstral-2-123b , FLUX-1.1-pro , FLUX.1-Kontext-pro , gemini-2.5-flash , gemini-2.5-pro , gemini-3.1-flash-image , gemini-3.1-flash-lite , gemini-3.1-pro-preview , gemini-3.5-flash , gemini-3.5-flash-lite , gemini-embedding-001 , gemma-3-12b , gemma-3-27b , gemma-3-4b , gpt-4.1 , gpt-4.1-mini , gpt-4.1-nano , gpt-4o , gpt-4o-mini-transcribe , gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize , gpt-5 , gpt-5-codex , gpt-5-mini , gpt-5-nano , gpt-5-pro , gpt-5.1 , gpt-5.1-codex , gpt-5.1-codex-max , gpt-5.1-codex-mini , gpt-5.2 , gpt-5.2-codex , gpt-5.3-codex , gpt-5.4 , gpt-5.4-mini , gpt-5.4-nano , gpt-5.4-pro , gpt-5.5 , gpt-5.6-luna , gpt-5.6-sol , gpt-5.6-terra , gpt-6-astra , gpt-audio , gpt-audio-1.5 , gpt-audio-mini , gpt-image-1-mini , gpt-image-1.5 , gpt-image-2 , gpt-image-2.5-flare , gpt-image-2.5-sunburst , gpt-oss-120b , gpt-oss-120b-aws , gpt-oss-20b , grok-4-1-fast-non-reasoning , grok-4-1-fast-reasoning , grok-4.3 , grok-4.6 , grok-code-fast-1 , kimi-k2-thinking , Kimi-K2.5 , kimi-k2.5-aws , Kimi-K2.6 , kimi-k3 , llama-3.1-70b , llama-3.1-8b , llama-3.3-70b , Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct , llama-4-maverick-17b , Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct-FP8 , llama-4-scout-17b , magistral-small-2509 , minimax-m2 , minimax-m2.1 , minimax-m2.5 , ministral-3-14b , ministral-3-3b , ministral-3-8b , Mistral-Large-3 , mistral-large-3-aws , mistral-medium-3-5 , nemotron-nano-12b-v2 , nemotron-nano-3-30b , nemotron-nano-9b-v2 , nemotron-super-3-120b , nova-2-lite , nova-lite , nova-micro , nova-pro , pixtral-large-2502 , qwen3-32b , qwen3-coder-30b-a3b , qwen3-coder-next , qwen3-next-80b-a3b , qwen3-vl-235b-a22b , text-embedding-3-large and text-embedding-3-small .
02 Your first call
Both examples below do the same thing: send one sentence to a model and print the
reply. Both read the key from an environment variable instead of hard-coding it in the
text — that's how to keep it out of your code. Put your key there first — every Aight key
starts with sk-aight- :
export AIGHT_API_KEY="sk-aight-..."
curl
curl https://api.getaight.ai/v1/chat/completions \
-H "Authorization: Bearer $AIGHT_API_KEY" \
-H "Content-Type: application/json" \
-d '{"model": "gpt-5.4-mini",
"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Say hello in Hindi."}]}'
Python
import os
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(base_url="https://api.getaight.ai/v1",
api_key=os.environ["AIGHT_API_KEY"])
reply = client.chat.completions.create(
model="gpt-5.4-mini",
messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Say hello in Hindi."}],
)
print(reply.choices[0].message.content)
That is the whole change. If you already have working OpenAI code, set
base_url to https://api.getaight.ai/v1 and
api_key to your Aight key, and run it.
Keep the key out of your code. A key in a file that reaches GitHub is
a key somebody else is spending. Tell us the moment you think a key has leaked and we
freeze it.
03 Getting a key
below is the only place on this page that
says how a key is obtained. Replacing that one paragraph is the whole change; no
other sentence on this page depends on it. -->
Two steps, and the first one is self-serve.
Create an account at
console.getaight.ai . It asks for your work
email, your business name, your state and your GSTIN. We approve new accounts within
24 hours, weekends included. Nothing can be spent before that.
We issue the key. Keys are still made by hand: once your account is
approved and your first top-up is credited, email
hello@getaight.ai with one line about what you
are building, and we reply within 24 hours with your key and the models it can call.
Making and revoking keys from the console yourself is not built yet.
04 Two rules before your first call
Neither of these is a surprise later. They decide whether your key works at all, so
they are here and not in the small print.
We approve every new account before it can pay. Approval happens
within 24 hours of your email, weekends included. Until then the key does not work.
You pay in rupees before you use anything. Your key works while the
balance lasts and stops the moment it runs out. There is no card on file, no monthly
bill and no debt.
That's four of the eight pricing rules — minimum top-up ₹500 ,
no expiry on your balance, unused balance refunded within 7 working days, one GST
invoice per top-up.
Read all eight before you email us.
Models are priced in dollars, so your balance is held in dollars and each top-up
converts at that day's rate, printed on the invoice.
A worked number, so nobody has to guess. Pay by UPI or bank transfer
and a ₹10,000 top-up costs you
₹11,800 : ₹10,000 of credit plus
18% GST. The invoice is domestic, in your own business name and GSTIN, so your
finance team can claim the GST back.
05 When a call fails
Write your software to branch on the HTTP status. The status is the
part that does not move. The English sentence in the body is for a human reading a log:
we may improve its words at any time, so do not match on them.
Where a refusal is ours rather than the model provider's, the error body also carries a
short machine-readable name in its param field, listed in the Code column
below. Everything in this table is what the gateway returns today, not what it will
return one day.
HTTP
Code
What happened
What to do
401
—
You sent no key, or a key we do not recognise.
Check the Authorization: Bearer header carries your Aight key, whole and unquoted. Keys start with sk-aight- . No key yet? Section 03 above.
402
out_of_balance
Your balance is finished. Every request is refused until we credit your next top-up. The body reads: “Out of balance. Top up at console.getaight.ai. Do not retry this request automatically; it will fail until you top up.”
Top up. Do not retry automatically — it will keep failing until the money lands. Already paid? Reply to your last email with the UTR.
403
key_cap_reached
This one key has spent its own cap. Your account balance may be untouched; the cap is a limit you or we set on the key. The body names the cap in dollars.
Use another key, or write to us to raise the cap. Do not retry: it will refuse until the cap moves.
403
—
Your key is not allowed to do this. Most often the model you named is not on your key's list.
Call GET /v1/models and use a name from that list, or write to us and we add the model to your key.
429
—
You sent more requests in one minute than your key allows. A 429 is never about money.
Wait the number of seconds in the Retry-After header, then send it again. Write to us if you need a higher limit.
503
balance_unverifiable
We could not check your balance, so we refused the request rather than guess. It was not run and you were not charged.
Try again in a few seconds.
Never retry a 402 automatically. A money refusal always arrives as a
402 and never as a 429 , so your retry logic can tell the two
apart. A 429 means slow down and try again. A 402 means stop and top up: a retry loop
on a 402 only burns your own machine.
403 also covers a key you have frozen, a key past its expiry date, and an
account we have put on hold. The sentence in the body says which one it is, and names
the number or the date.
06 When something breaks
Write to hello@getaight.ai . We read that
inbox from 9 am to 9 pm IST, seven days a week . A founder replies —
not a ticket queue.
Three things in the email get you an answer in one reply instead of three.
The HTTP status and the sentence from the error body, copied exactly.
The date and time of the failed request, with the time zone.
The model name you asked for.
That is enough for us to find the request in the log. Never send us the key itself. If
you think a key has leaked, say so in the first line and we freeze it before we read
the rest.
07 The small print
Three pages, in the same plain English as this one. Read them before you pay, not after.
Terms Terms and Conditions — what you buy, our liability, acceptable use
Privacy Privacy Policy — what we store about your requests, and for how long
Refunds Refund and Cancellation Policy — unused balance back within 7 working days
Entity Ashva Intelligence Pvt Ltd
CIN U62099HR2026PTC147038
GSTIN 06ABFCA9973K1Z2
See also
Pricing rules
Terms
Privacy
Refunds & cancellations
Contact us
